title: 3i Group: Capital in Action - [Business Breakdowns, EP.180]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today we are breaking down the publicly traded investment company 3i.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down the publicly traded investment company 3i. You may think if you've seen one publicly traded investment vehicle, you've seen them all. Yet, 3i is an investment vehicle where one business, Dutch retailer, Action, represents well north of 50% of their net asset value.

key_points.text: Our guest to break down 3i is Luke Bridgeman, a partner and portfolio manager at Hosking Partners.
Luke shares the unique origin story of 3i, which dates back to pre-World War II in England.
He takes us up through the present day.
